{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
completed_cleaned = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute and print the number of completed orders and cleaned completed orders
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_df)}")
print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA orders: {len(completed_cleaned)}")

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_cleaned['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")

# Output the final value
mean_revenue"}
